hotel.eventDescription: One delivered Booking.com hotel row with a non-null reported stay price: $4 per 1,000 rows. Row keys include hotel_id, name, price_total, price_nightly, currency, taxes_fees_excluded, taxes_included, free_cancellation, no_prepayment, breakfast_included, room_name, check_in and check_out. Reported prices and badges are search-result indicators, not a verified payable total or complete same-rate policy/eligibility contract; missing badge data can become false. Unpriced/sold-out hotel rows, filtered rows, duplicates, status rows, bad input and failed/empty searches are not charged. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option; the run stops at that ceiling.

room.eventDescription: One delivered matching room/rate block from Booking's returned search result, only when includeRooms=true: $2 per 1,000 rows. Row keys include hotel_id, room_id, room_name, occupancy, meal_plan, meal_plan_id, policy_group_id, price_total, currency, price_original, original_currency, free_cancellation_until and only_x_left. Optional source fields, including price, can be null. original_currency belongs to the block originalPrice; it is not verified as hotel currency. Cancellation text is not a complete penalty/payment contract. These blocks are not exhaustive inventory. rooms_listed counts returned blocks before the run spending cap; no separate room cap. No charge when includeRooms=false. No start fee; proxy and compute included.
